purpose: Authoritative given_name/surname divisions for the AFLDB-ISSUE-224 S9 target-set rows whose display name carries three or more tokens. tools/rebuild/draftguru/register_issue224_s9_players.ts refuses such a row outright rather than last-token-splitting it; this artefact is how the operator supplies the division, via --name-parts.
authority: AFL Tables / fitzRoy source pinned as issue224-inseason-20260919.
contract: Every row must name an afltables_external_id present in the pinned target set, must repeat that target's display_name byte-for-byte, and must recompose (given_name + ' ' + surname) to it. The runner enforces all three. This artefact is deliberately NOT hash-pinned: unlike issue224-s9-target-set-20260922.json and issue224-d7-registration-decision-20260922.json it is authored per run, and its safety comes from being validated against those pinned artefacts.
